title: Tôi bị dị ứng đậu phộng
pronunciation: toy bee zee oong dow fohng
summary: Say "I am allergic to peanuts" with Tôi bị dị ứng đậu phộng, then use the notes below to adjust tone and next steps.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi bị dị ứng đậu phộng answers the traveler question "I am allergic to peanuts" in ordering, adjusting dishes, and checking ingredients. This comes before you order when peanuts are the main food risk. Lead with the allergy warning, then ask about ingredients if needed. Its job is stating the limit before the order or interaction moves too far. The forms below show how tone, setting, or politeness changes the best choice.
